messages:
Maya: Quick sync — final SEO ops checklist for the microlaunch + webinar (next Wed). Need: keyword priority list, snippet schema, internal link map, and redirects for legacy pages. :rocket:

Zane: I'll run keyword delta vs last launch. Do you want to pin primary KW to launch page or split CTAs? :thinking:

Maya: Pin primary to /launch/ (canonical). Blog posts should canonicalize to /launch/ where the intent is product-first. Secondary content can keep blog canonical for educational pieces.

Leo: On redirects — do we keep 301s for old campaign slugs or temporary 302 for AB test lanes?

Maya: 301 for old marketing pages. For test lanes use query params with 302 and track with UTM. OpsBot: redirect-checker: staging has 3 conflicts (see below).

OpsBot: /old-offer -> /launch (301)
OpsBot: /webinar-signup-old -> /webinar/register (conflict: also redirected to /lp-webinar)

Zoe: Will update the internal links doc and add anchor recommendations. Suggestion: add keyword-rich anchor on top nav CTA to /launch.

Sam: I'll patch the schema snippets on docs site. Example payload (for the CTA hero):
```
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "WebPage",
  "name": "Redwood Inference — Launch",
  "description": "High-performance LLM inference platform for production",
  "primaryImageOfPage": "https://redwood.ai/assets/launch-hero.png",
  "mainEntity": {
    "@type": "Product",
    "name": "Redwood Inference",
    "offers": {"@type": "Offer", "url": "https://redwood.ai/launch"}
  }
}
```

Maya: Perfect. Can someone own the redirect orchestration + final QA by EOD Friday? We need no redirect loops and canonical coverage in the sitemap.

Zane: I'll take redirects + sitemap check.

Leo: I'll run a preflight crawl with the QA checklist and post the CSV.

Zoe: I'll finish internal link map and share the heatmap layer.

Sam: Schema snippets and meta tags — on my list, will PR by Thursday.

Maya: Great — attach any blockers here. Also adding a short prompt set for Redwood Optimize tests to watch CTR changes after changes :mag_right:
